summary: Lakeshore Acquisition III Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K on May 22, 2026, disclosing entry into a merger agreement with CPRO Electronics Holding Limited and its subsidiary. The SPAC will first undergo a reincorporation merger into a Cayman subsidiary, then Merger Sub will merge with CPRO Korea. No specific price per share, premium, or valuation was disclosed. The board issued no recommendation in the excerpt. Structural notes include automatic unit separation and share conversion. A risk-arb angle awaits definitive valuation, shareholder vote, and regulatory approvals with a timeline to close.
